category_description: Startups in autonomous defense systems develop unmanned platforms for air, land, and sea operations. These include autonomous drones, robotic ground vehicles, and naval unmanned vessels. The focus is on reducing human exposure in high-risk environments. Many companies integrate AI-based navigation and target recognition. Dual-use applications extend into disaster response and border security. This category is central to next-generation battlefield modernization.
